trap.label: passado em narrativa
trap.wrong: Helen understand “water” and she used to refuse at first.
trap.right: Helen understood “water.” At first she refused.
trap.why: Em português “entendeu”/“recusou” no pretérito; o brasileiro puxa a forma regular para irregular (understanded). Em inglês, understand → understood; fato único = Past Simple.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “She understands the word.”
Reescreva com used to: “She spelled words every day.”
rewrite.answer: She used to spell words every day.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “At first she refuses.”
